subject: Anonymised participant (consented)
notes: Bilateral moderate-to-severe sloping sensorineural loss. Pure-tone averages in the moderate-severe range, but QuickSIN speech-in-noise testing shows severe SNR loss on multiple conditions. Clinic notes maximum SNR improvement needed (directional/array microphones or FM-style system). Participant uses Phonak aids with Roger. Explicit consent given 23 Aug 2026 for anonymised use in OpenHear Living Hearing Profile materials and public examples. Demonstrates the pure-tone vs functional speech-in-noise gap that a Living Hearing Profile is designed to capture.
